bible: Arizona Chimney Pros lives inside upscale modern-Southwest Phoenix/Scottsdale homes at 4–6 pm: hand-troweled plaster or stacked-stone surrounds, honed travertine, tall glass onto saguaro, palo verde and desert mountains, with amber window light as key and ember-orange fire glow as the only saturated accent against charcoal shadow and warm ivory stone — never blue or teal. The technician is a craftsman, not a model: one athletic adult, plain charcoal work shirt, dark cap or none, seen at mid distance from behind or three-quarter with honest, anatomically correct hands and never a tight portrait or stock smile. Every frame is photoreal on 35–50 mm with real optical depth and editorial-documentary realism plus commercial polish — no 3D sheen, illustration or HDR — and carries zero text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, screens, plates or lettering.

about-hero.prompt:
SUBJECT: Wide editorial photograph, luxury modern-Southwest Arizona living room: lit sandstone fireplace glowing lower-left, tall windows right framing saguaro, palo verde and desert mountains in late-afternoon gold. One technician, small at lower-left, kneels at the hearth, charcoal work shirt, back three-quarter to camera, face turned into the firebox.
COMPOSITION: 16:9. Centre band is a broad, smooth warm-ivory plaster wall in soft shadow, no objects, edges or texture, copy-safe for a centred headline and clean under a 4:5 centre crop. Interest at the edges and bottom third: ember glow and hearth lower-left, low linen sofa and travertine floor along the bottom, desert window right; figure under one-tenth frame height.
CAMERA: 35 mm full-frame, eye level, f/4, deep focus, photoreal.
LIGHT: 5 pm amber sun raking the floor; ember-orange glow on hearth and shoulder; charcoal upper corners.
MATERIALS: lime plaster, honed travertine, sandstone, walnut, linen.
EXCLUSIONS: no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, screens, watermarks; no faces near centre; no blue or teal grading; no 3D-render sheen, illustration or stock smile.
about-hero.alt: Luxury Arizona living room at golden hour with a lit stone fireplace, tall windows onto the desert, and a technician working quietly at the hearth.

about-story.prompt:
SUBJECT: A technician kneels on the travertine hearth of an upscale Arizona home, lit torch in hand, tools on a canvas roll, checking the gas burner inside the firebox. Three-quarter from behind and side so hands, flame and burner are the subject; face in soft profile at mid distance. One athletic adult, charcoal work shirt, dark cap, correct five-finger hands.
COMPOSITION: 4:5 vertical. Full-height figure, generous headroom: top fifth quiet plaster wall and a tall window's edge; back and shoulder on the left third, firebox glow right of centre; hearth and tools fill the lower third.
CAMERA: 50 mm, hearth height, f/2.8, focus on hands and burner, soft falloff, photoreal.
LIGHT: ember-orange glow on hands, tools and jawline; amber desert window rims shoulder and cap at right; charcoal shadow behind.
MATERIALS: hand-troweled plaster, split-face stone, honed travertine, brass burner, steel tools, canvas roll.
EXCLUSIONS: no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, screens; no tight portrait or stock smile; no blue or teal grading; no 3D render or illustration.
about-story.alt: Chimney technician kneeling at a gas fireplace in an Arizona home, checking the burner with a torch, warm fire glow on his hands and tools.
